name: ALeRCE ZTF API

provider.name: ALeRCE (Automatic Learning for the Rapid Classification of Events) broker

summary: ZTF transient and variable objects with machine-learning classifications, detections, non-detections, light curves and features from the ALeRCE alert broker, free without a key.
description: The API lists ZTF objects filtered by classifier, class, probability, number of detections, dates and sky position, and returns per-object detections, non-detections, magnitude statistics, features, probabilities and light curves. Classifiers include lc_classifier and its transient and stochastic variants; classes include SNIa, SNII, QSO, AGN and variable-star types. Filtering on lc_classifier and SNIa with count=true reported 35,756 objects on 2026-11-13.

endpoints.summary: List objects by filters; returns items plus paging fields
One object by ZTF object id (for example ZTF20aaelulu)
Detections and non-detections for an object

license.name: Not stated on the API, the Swagger page or the project site pages checked

coverage.temporal: ZTF alert stream from 2018 to the present

agent_notes: Add count=true to get total and a working next/has_next; without it total is null and has_next is false even when more pages exist (page=2 still returns rows). Sort with order_by and order_mode. classifier and class go together: call /classifiers/ for valid names. Probabilities are per classifier, so low values are normal for an unthresholded class filter.
caveats: Without count=true the response reports total null and has_next false although later pages exist (checked with page=2).
CORS reflected the request Origin (https://example.org and https://other.example.org were both echoed).
The first rows for class=SNIa have probabilities around 0.17 to 0.22; filter by probability yourself for confident supernovae.
No licence, rate limit or citation text was found in the pages fetched.
The example response shows the unfiltered count fields as null; ndethist is a string while other counts are numbers.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without credentials; 2.2 s on 2026-11-13.
